meeting.title: Loop Returns working session — dashboard build
meeting.summary: Technical working session with Loop Returns. Maya to migrate the two returns-ops dashboards; Jonah to add the metrics block to fct_returns.yml; Rosa raised exec rollup for a later sprint.
action_items: Maya to migrate the two returns-ops dashboards by end of week
Jonah to add metrics block to fct_returns.yml before Monday sync
key_decisions: Returns-ops dashboards are the migration priority, exec rollup waits
meeting.notes: Exec rollup dashboard deliberately deferred — Rosa to raise it again next sprint planning.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Okay, screen's shared. Today I want to lock the dashboard migration order and unblock the returns metrics.

transcript.speaker: Jonah Fields
transcript.text: The two returns-ops dashboards are what the team checks every morning, so those first please.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Makes sense. I'll migrate the two returns-ops dashboards into Quarry by end of the week — Friday at the latest.

transcript.speaker: Jonah Fields
transcript.text: Nice. They lean on fct_returns pretty heavily though, and that model has no metrics defined yet.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Right — I can only wire the tiles up once the metrics exist in the yml.

transcript.speaker: Jonah Fields
transcript.text: That's on me. I'll add the metrics block to fct_returns.yml before our Monday sync — return rate, refund value, and processing time.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Those three cover both dashboards, perfect.

transcript.speaker: Rosa Delgado
transcript.text: While we're here — leadership keeps asking for a single exec rollup view. Where would that fit?

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: After the ops dashboards, honestly. It needs the same metrics plus a few we haven't modeled.

transcript.speaker: Rosa Delgado
transcript.text: Fine. I'll own building the exec rollup dashboard once the ops ones land — I'll pick it up sometime next sprint, no hard date yet.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Deal, and I'll review it when you have a draft.

transcript.speaker: Jonah Fields
transcript.text: One more thing — do we want dbt exposures declared for these dashboards?

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Nice to have. Maybe we look at exposures down the line, but let's not add scope this week.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Recap: dashboards on me by Friday, fct_returns metrics on Jonah before Monday, exec rollup with Rosa next sprint.
